name: xrefs
description: Return analyzed references to a code or data address. Hopper may default to its current cursor; headless providers such as Ghidra require an explicit address. Kuna also accepts names in its own inventory, including data names; an unlisted name may still exist in the target. Use to connect strings, globals, selectors, and functions; bare addresses are untyped and indirect references may be incomplete. Page a retained result with inspect_analysis_view and native-observation; use native-context for source caveats. Use inspect_native_instruction at the target address for typed incoming references where supported.
